narr: An area of upper level low pressure brought repetitive rounds of slow moving thunderstorms to parts of Virginia. The heaviest rain fell across Loudoun County, Virginia and King George County, VA where to two to four inches of rain were observed.
ev: Blue Ridge VFD reported at least six inches of high water flowing over multiple roads. Several basements flooded.
lsr: Blue Ridge VFD reported several calls for high water flowing across roads and water in basements.
